posts.text:
Bank credit to services grew 24.3% in Aug 2026, against 18.8% for all bank credit.

Services is 28.3% of the book but took 35.0% of the new credit. Industry grew 18.2%, personal loans 16.9%.

#BankCredit #IndianBanking #RBI

posts.text:
Consumer durable loans, Aug 2026:

Banks: ₹23,295 Cr, +2.4% over the year.
NBFCs: ₹77,784 Cr, +56.4%.

The product has moved off bank books. Point-of-sale finance at work?

(NBFCs: RBI's reporting sample.)
#NBFC #ConsumerFinance #BankCredit

posts.text:
HDFC Bank's credit card spend at shops grew 0.9% in Aug 2026. The market grew 9.1%; SBI 22.3%, Axis 11.6%, ICICI −5.1%.

A year ago HDFC was growing 28.3%. Base effect, or is the lead fading?

#CreditCards #DigitalPayments #HDFCBank

posts.text:
Bank credit to petroleum, coal and nuclear fuels grew 14.8% in Aug 2026. Net of fuel prices it fell 17.1%: wholesale mineral-oil prices rose 38.5% over the year.

More rupees, less fuel financed.

#BankCredit #WPI #Inflation

posts.text:
Gold loans, Aug 2026.

Banks: ₹5.59L Cr, +83.2%. 24.1% of new personal loans, from 7.7% of the book.
NBFCs: ₹3.65L Cr, +69.1%. 31.2% of new retail credit.

Rising gold prices, or rising demand?
